data_fields.name: sanitize_range_per_field
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: [min, max] per declared input field; NaN goes to min; a field never received is left alone

best_idea: Sanitize every decoded input field in place before anything reads it (clamp, never reject), dedupe packets by their sequence number, and keep a bounded per-client input ring, so a late or replayed packet cannot run an input twice.
decision_why: Take the clamp-then-dedupe-then-bounded-ring order, but do not ack an overflowed input (the donor acks it, which would tell a duel client a dropped attack was received), and add a counter for clamped values because the donor clamps silently.
acceptance: A server test sends 40 unreliable input frames with seq 1 to 40 into a 32-slot intake ring: frames 1 to 8 are not acked and the client gets a dropped count; a steering value of 5 on a [-1, 1] field reaches the duel step as 1; a replayed seq 17 changes nothing.
